prompt.zh: 重要安排由我参与决定时，我更愿意投入。
prompt.en: I am more willing to get involved when I have a say in important arrangements.

prompt.zh: 做事方式可以自己选择时，我会感到更有动力。
prompt.en: I feel more motivated when I can choose how to do something.

prompt.zh: 被直接替我决定时，我会想重新争取选择空间。
prompt.en: When decisions are made for me, I want to regain some room to choose.

prompt.zh: 规划一周时，我重视保留能由自己安排的时间。
prompt.en: When planning a week, I value keeping some time that I can arrange myself.

prompt.zh: 经历重要事情后，我希望能和信任的人分享。
prompt.en: After something important happens, I want to share it with someone I trust.

prompt.zh: 在一个群体中感到被接纳，会明显影响我的投入。
prompt.en: Feeling accepted in a group noticeably affects how involved I become.

prompt.zh: 遇到困难时，我会在意是否有人可以一起面对。
prompt.en: When facing a difficulty, I care about whether someone can face it with me.

prompt.zh: 长期独自推进事情时，我会想寻找稳定的连接。
prompt.en: After working on something alone for a long time, I want a steady connection with others.

prompt.zh: 看见自己比上次更熟练，会让我愿意继续。
prompt.en: Seeing that I am more skilled than last time makes me want to continue.

prompt.zh: 我愿意为掌握一项重要技能重复练习。
prompt.en: I am willing to practice repeatedly to master an important skill.

prompt.zh: 遇到有难度但可推进的任务时，我容易集中注意。
prompt.en: I find it easier to focus on a task that is challenging but possible to make progress on.

prompt.zh: 具体反馈能帮助我决定下一步怎样改进。
prompt.en: Specific feedback helps me decide what to improve next.

prompt.zh: 重要安排有清楚范围时，我更容易放松。
prompt.en: I find it easier to relax when important arrangements have a clear scope.

prompt.zh: 面对变化前，我会想先确认基本资源是否足够。
prompt.en: Before facing a change, I want to check whether basic resources are sufficient.

prompt.zh: 知道接下来大致会发生什么，会增加我的行动余量。
prompt.en: Having a general idea of what will happen next gives me more room to act.

prompt.zh: 风险不明确时，我会优先收集能提高可预期性的信息。
prompt.en: When risks are unclear, I first gather information that can make things more predictable.

prompt.zh: 自己的贡献被具体指出时，我会更确认投入的意义。
prompt.en: When someone identifies my contribution specifically, I feel clearer about why my effort matters.

prompt.zh: 完成共同任务后，我希望知道自己的部分产生了什么影响。
prompt.en: After a shared task, I want to know what effect my part had.

prompt.zh: 长期没有反馈时，我会想确认自己的努力是否被看见。
prompt.en: After a long period without feedback, I want to check whether my effort has been noticed.

prompt.zh: 获得与实际贡献对应的认可，会增强我继续参与的意愿。
prompt.en: Recognition that reflects my actual contribution strengthens my willingness to keep participating.

prompt.zh: 接触新的观点或做法会让我产生继续了解的兴趣。
prompt.en: Encountering a new idea or approach makes me interested in learning more.

prompt.zh: 长期重复同一种安排时，我会想加入一些变化。
prompt.en: After repeating the same arrangement for a long time, I want to introduce some change.

prompt.zh: 有机会试验不同路径时，我愿意先做小范围尝试。
prompt.en: When I can try a different route, I am willing to start with a small experiment.

prompt.zh: 未知中存在可控空间时，我容易被新的可能吸引。
prompt.en: When there is some manageable room within the unknown, new possibilities easily attract me.

label.en: Uncertain or depends on the situation
Cannot judge / prefer not to answer — unscored
label.zh: 无法判断／暂不回答——不计分
